```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(class)
library(caret)
```

```{r}
clean_song_data <- readRDS("song_longevity.rds")
```

# Split Data

```{r}
# KNN needs all-numeric inputs on the same scale, so first dummy-code the
# factors (genre, label_tier) and then min-max normalize every predictor.
# slow_burner is dropped because it is another outcome label, not a predictor.
knn_data <- clean_song_data
knn_data$slow_burner <- NULL

knn_x <- as.data.frame(model.matrix(is_hit ~ . - 1, data = knn_data))
knn_y <- as.factor(knn_data$is_hit)

normalize <- function(x) {
  (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))
}
knn_x <- as.data.frame(lapply(knn_x, normalize))

# 70/30 train/test split
set.seed(12345)
train_rows <- sample(1:nrow(knn_x), 0.7 * nrow(knn_x))

knn_train <- knn_x[train_rows, ]
knn_test <- knn_x[-train_rows, ]
knn_train_labels <- knn_y[train_rows]
knn_test_labels <- knn_y[-train_rows]

# Check that both sets have a similar share of hits
prop.table(table(knn_train_labels))
prop.table(table(knn_test_labels))
```

# Create Model and step along different K

```{r}
# Only ~10% of songs are hits, so accuracy alone is misleading (predicting
# "not a hit" every time is already ~90% accurate). Track kappa as well.
k_values <- seq(1, 39, by = 2)
k_results <- data.frame(k = k_values, accuracy = NA, kappa = NA,
                        sensitivity = NA, specificity = NA)

for (i in seq_along(k_values)) {
  knn_pred <- knn(train = knn_train, test = knn_test,
                  cl = knn_train_labels, k = k_values[i])
  cm <- confusionMatrix(knn_pred, knn_test_labels, positive = "1")
  k_results$accuracy[i] <- cm$overall["Accuracy"]
  k_results$kappa[i] <- cm$overall["Kappa"]
  k_results$sensitivity[i] <- cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]
  k_results$specificity[i] <- cm$byClass["Specificity"]
}

k_results
```

```{r}
plot(k_results$k, k_results$kappa, type = "b", pch = 19,
     xlab = "K", ylab = "Kappa", main = "KNN Kappa by K")
```

# Pick best K

```{r}
best_k <- k_results$k[which.max(k_results$kappa)]
best_k

knn_best_pred <- knn(train = knn_train, test = knn_test,
                     cl = knn_train_labels, k = best_k)
confusionMatrix(knn_best_pred, knn_test_labels, positive = "1")
```
